name: @agent-org/plugin-slack
description: The Slack publisher: announces the pull requests a person chose, through a publish run that posts to Slack with the post-pr-to-slack skill.

agentOrg.description: Slack: announces the pull requests a person chose, through a publish run.

run.explanation: The publish run's instruction, with {prs} filled in with the ticked runs' open pull requests, one per line, and {dir} with its folder. NBL's: Run the post-pr-to-slack skill on these pull requests, all in one go: {prs}. Then write {dir}/published.json, with its Slack send tool in tickets.providers.publish.connectors.
run.breaks: Without both placeholders it is refused by name.

edit.dangerous: This is the publish run: a wrong instruction lets it act outside the machine or in the person's accounts.

model.explanation: The model the publish run runs on.
model.breaks: A name the runner does not know fails the publish run.

effort.explanation: The effort the publish run runs with.
effort.breaks: An effort the runner does not know fails the publish run.

connectors.explanation: Connector tools the publish run alone may call, beside tickets.connectors. Such as Slack's send.
connectors.breaks: A pattern not starting ^mcp__ is refused by name.

edit.dangerous: The publish run may call these connector tools, so a broad pattern lets it act in the person's connected accounts.
